prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1133; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the shop following a side impact at an intersection. Damage is concentrated on the driver-side rear quarter panel, with a crushed rear door, a cracked taillight housing, and scuffing along the rocker panel. The pattern is largely consistent with the reported collision direction. Repair plan calls for panel replacement, door realignment, and refinishing of the adjoining surfaces. The labor hours listed fit the scope of this damage, and the supplied invoices show no duplicated line items. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record. Estimate recommended for approval as submitted.
